say:0:1621320001:0.text: I just tidied up the room... and sorted out the Memory Stars...
say:0:1621320001:0.source_cn: 塔塔刚收拾好的房间……分门别类摆放的记忆之星……

say:1:1621320002:0.text: Don't worry, Cranky! I'll seal it at once and help you clean.
say:1:1621320002:0.source_cn: 尽快封印那只魔物吧，救救多灾多难的研究区域……
